description: Rate quote request, not an order

email.subject: Rate request - Grand Rapids MI to St. Louis MO
email.body:
Hi there,

Working on pricing for a customer and need a rate on the lane below. They're still shopping it around, so I just need a number for now. If it works I'll come back with a firm date and PO.

Origin: Grand Rapids, MI 49548 (Lakeview Office Furniture, dock pickup)
Destination: St. Louis, MO 63110
Freight: 14 pallets office chairs, boxed, approx 9,800 lbs, 53' dry van, no stacking
Timing would probably be the first week of December, flexible on the day.

Can you send all-in pricing incl fuel? Also let me know if you'd charge extra for a liftgate at delivery, the consignee might not have a dock.

Thanks,
Kevin Ostrowski
Senior Account Rep
Great Lakes Freight Partners LLC
(616) 555-0148
